title: SCPP: A Unified Python Library for Soft Clustering
description: A Python library of soft and fuzzy clustering algorithms, providing membership-based, possibilistic, evidential, graph, document and deep clustering models behind one estimator protocol, together with a benchmarking suite for evaluating them on equal terms.
